mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 370000) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market, which may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 208.0) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 208.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 115) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0), a low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 115) indicates economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST < 1500) indicates a cooling housing market, which signals reduced consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 115) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0.
